### 1. User expression and simulator role

Marguerite Ostrowski, owner of Lakeside Bay Self Storage LLC: *"We're taking the solar array off the roof for good, so I want to end our net metering agreement but keep our electric service, and have whatever solar credit is left paid out to us."* Electric service stays on; no move, no buyer. Lookup by phone 6164507219; verification EIN-last-4 8315 + ZIP 49431. Consents if "something has to be booked or settled on the solar account before it can be closed out"; accepts the amounts; runs the handed-over tool herself with the agreement number and the two amounts as given. Simulator is passive and conditional.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, root last. Grounds:
- `find_service_accounts`: SA `b8ee4df5-1ba5-411c-a6e2-1078754290c2`, *Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service*, `active`.
- `find_nem_agreements`: `9db2120a-39a9-4eaa-baab-5e1753b55d9c`, *Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff*, `operating`, PTO 2024-07-09, 38.4 kW AC, `solar_pv_with_storage`, 30.0 kWh battery, true_up_month `07`, bank 613.46.
- `doc_nem_requested_termination_3810cf0f` scope: "the customer's own decision to end an operating net metering agreement while keeping electric service at the address, under a rider whose termination disposition is cash out"; NBT-C termination disposition Cash out (`doc_nem_true_up_and_settlement_terms_7c28ac56`).
- Wait condition (same doc): "The requested-termination settlement is not fixed until the bank carries the anniversary cash-out owed for every true-up bill issued since permission to operate." True-up bills (bills dated in July): 2025-07-14 → history has anniversary payout `7f109418…` dated 2025-07-18 (134.83, check); 2026-07-14 (`609dc7a4…`) → no anniversary payout in the history. Root blocked.

### 3. Object, keys, rows

Agreement `9db2120a-…` on SA `b8ee4df5-…`. Ledger: monthly EXP / GAC (35.71 = 0.93 × 38.4) / APP for BPE 2024-08-10 … 2026-07-10; one anniversary payout 2025-07-18. Bills 2024-08-14 … 2026-07-14, all regular; estimated: 2025-07-14 and 2026-02-14. Meters: AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter `in_service`; Standard AMI Smart Meter `removed`. DR: Commercial Capacity Bidding Program `active`. Rows excluded from 12-month windows ending 2026-07-22: BPE 2025-07-10 and the 2025-07-14 bill (both before 2025-07-22).

### 4. Scored parameters

Cross-product figure note: two tiers read a property of the hosting rate schedule — whether Schedule GST "has on-peak hours" and its "demand charge per kW". No runtime-corpus document states Schedule GST figures. The schedule's name ("Time-of-Use"), the bills' on-peak kWh split, and `demand_charge_amount` 0.00 / `billing_demand_kw` 0.0 on all 24 bills were used as the record evidence. Inference, recorded as such.

**(a) Expired carried credit** (baseline `doc_nem_expired_carried_credit_computation_687d0002`; booking day 2026-07-22). Closing true-up year = periods BPE 2025-08-10 … 2026-07-10 (12). Year's exports 1396.69; year's applied 1095.09; carried = 613.46 − 1396.69 + 1095.09 = 311.86.
- Carried credit used (`doc_nem_carried_credit_drawing_order_9eca932b`): avoided-cost rider, schedule with on-peak hours → applied in excess of exports = 0 (1095.09 < 1396.69). Led there by: rider, schedule name. (Flat alternative would give 199.89; baseline min() gives 311.86.)
- Reserve (`doc_nem_estimated_read_reserve_d10b8908`): estimated bills dated in the 12 months before the expiry: 2026-02-14 only → 1 month → 1095.09 / 12 = 91.2575 → 91.26.
- Expiry share (`doc_nem_tenure_expiry_share_5ec913d1`): PTO 2024-07-09 → 2026-07-22 = 24 whole months → 0.75.
- Exempt (`doc_nem_grid_access_exempt_amount_b531b868`): avoided-cost rider; GAC for periods in the 12 months 12 × 35.71 = 428.52 ≥ 300.00 → 25.00.
- Expired = (311.86 − 0 − 91.26) × 0.75 − 25.00 = 165.45 − 25.00 = **140.45**. Bank → 473.01.
- Fall-back (baseline only): used = 311.86 → expired 0.00 (nothing booked) — definite and different.

**(b) Anniversary cash-out** (baseline `doc_nem_anniversary_cash_out_computation_b3f91628`). Bank 473.01.
- Average monthly applied credit (`doc_nem_applied_credit_averaging_16e38b06`): 12 regular bills dated in the 12 months, 1 estimated → 1095.09 / 12 = **91.26**.
- Retention months (`doc_nem_winter_retention_months_a3551ec0`): winter energy+PSCR 811.28 / all 1095.09 = 0.74083 → 0.7408 ≥ 0.60 → **2**.
- Fixed retention (`doc_nem_fixed_business_retention_073ec2a4`): business rider, schedule bills no demand charge (0.00 on every bill) → **120.00**.
- Storage retention rate (`doc_nem_battery_storage_retention_4d9797a2`): 30 kWh battery, active DR enrollment → 0.50 → 15.00. Led there by: `find_dr_enrollments` (Demand Response Programs record, status `active`).
- Estimate buffer (`doc_nem_estimated_bill_buffer_4c467ab0`): 1 estimated bill in the 12 months, most recent bill (2026-07-14) actual → 20.00 per bill → 20.00.
- Retained = 2 × 91.26 + 120.00 + 15.00 + 20.00 = **337.52**; cash-out = 473.01 − 337.52 = **135.49** (≥ 100.00 → check). Bank → 337.52.
- Fall-back (baseline: avg = 70.25 from the most recent bill, every retention part none): retained 0.00, cash-out 473.01 — different.

**(c) Requested-termination payout** (baseline `doc_nem_requested_termination_payout_computation_6a3220ee`). Bank 337.52.
- Early exit (`doc_nem_early_exit_charge_99f9121c`): 24 months < 108 (NBT-C lock 9 years), battery paired → 38.4 × 2.50 = **96.00**.
- Meter reconfiguration (`doc_nem_meter_reconfiguration_charge_8f31ddf7`): AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter in service → **60.00**. Led there by: `find_meter_installations` (Metering Service record).
- Open-period holdback (`doc_nem_open_period_holdback_23a7b253`): most recent bill 2026-07-14 `summer`, TOU schedule → 0.20 × 224.79 (EXP BPE 2026-07-10) = 44.958 → **44.96**.
- Paid share (`doc_nem_termination_paid_share_853eb451`): avoided-cost rider, active DR enrollment → **0.95**.
- Payout = (337.52 − 96.00 − 60.00 − 44.96) × 0.95 = 136.56 × 0.95 = 129.732 → **129.73** (≥ 100.00 → check); surrendered = 337.52 − 129.73 = **207.79**.
- Fall-back (baseline): payout 337.52, surrendered 0.00 — different.

Terminal: agreement terminated, bank 0.00, electric service unchanged.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone

P1 requested termination (root, customer's write); P2 anniversary cash-out at the 2026-07-14 true-up bill; P3 expiry of carried credit for the closing true-up year. P1 waits on P2; P2 waits on P3. Order P3 → P2 → P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "not fixed until the bank carries the anniversary cash-out owed for every true-up bill issued since permission to operate." Records: true-up month 07; July bills 2025-07-14 (payout present) and 2026-07-14 (none). Searching "anniversary cash-out": `doc_nem_anniversary_cash_out_ee8b62be` "governs the anniversary cash-out booked at the bill dated in the true-up month of an operating agreement under a rider whose true-up disposition is cash out" (NBT-C: Cash out) and "After the cash-out the net metering history shows an anniversary payout paid by check".
- Hop P2 → P3 — **state-derived**. Sentence (anniversary doc): "The anniversary cash-out is fixed only after the bank carries the expiry entry owed for credit carried into the closing true-up year and left unused by its bills." Records: no anniversary forfeiture entry in the history. Searching "expiry"/"carried credit": `doc_nem_carried_credit_expiry_f71dc00c` "credit carried into the closing true-up year and left unused by its bills expires and is booked as an anniversary forfeiture"; NBT-C "Applies"; the worksheet + factors give 140.45 > 0, so an entry is owed.
- P3's documents state no waited-on state. No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool or chains the three.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Do only the termination now (bank 613.46): excluded by "While the bank lacks the anniversary cash-out owed for any such true-up bill, the requested-termination settlement is not fixed."
- Cash out before the expiry: excluded by "Until the bank carries that expiry entry, the anniversary cash-out is not fixed."
- Move-out rule: excluded — SA `active`, service continues.
- Paid share 0.85: excluded — DR enrollment `active`. Storage rate 1.50: same.
- Meter charge 35.00: excluded — the bidirectional single-phase type is not in service; the three-phase meter is.
- Early exit flat 75.00: excluded — battery 30 kWh recorded.
- Reserve 2 months / buffer count 2 / 3-month averaging: excluded — the 2025-07-14 estimated bill is dated before the 12-month window (2025-07-22).
- Expiry share none (<24 months): excluded — 24 whole months reached on 2026-07-09.
- Proportional drawing order (199.89 used): excluded — Schedule GST is time-of-use.
- Fixed retention 200.00: excluded only by the bills' zero demand charge (schedule figure not published in the runtime corpus).

contamination_disclosure: none.
